summary: Phase 16 Demo Sandbox Engine testing completed. Backend fully functional (11/11 tests passed). Frontend partially working: case detail page, demo CTA, and gate form work correctly, but demo app crashes due to JavaScript errors.

critical_bugs.impact: Demo app initialization fails when trying to fetch document templates

integration_issues.issue: Demo app fails to initialize properly after successful session creation and redirect
